title: Ship look values
description: The file game/tuning/ship_look.json: when the ship leans, when its air streaks show and how fast its flame flickers, read in both run modes. The file must exist; every field is optional, and a field left out keeps its default from game/ui/ship_view.py (DEFAULT_SHIP_LOOK). {} is a valid file. All defaults are guesses (04-ship.md, look); tune them by eye. Loaded and checked by game/app/ship_tuning.py at startup into ui.ship_view.ShipLook. Look only: no field changes play. Owner of the schema: architect.

lean_speed.description: Sideways speed in px/tick from which the ship leans, left or right. Top sideways speed is about 6.6.

streak_speed.description: Sideways speed in px/tick from which short air streaks trail behind the ship.

streak_long_speed.description: Sideways speed in px/tick from which the air streaks are long. Must be greater than streak_speed.

flame_ticks_per_frame.description: Ticks each flame and streak flicker frame is shown. 60 ticks = 1 second.
